{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:XizorVulcanMindMeld-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] uses pheromones in an attempt to seduce [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].]]
{{Quote|Your pheromonal attractant was insufficient to bend her to your will; that has never happened before.''"<br />"''I ''had'' noticed that, thank you.''"<br />"''This failure has made her more appealing.|[[Guri]] and [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] discuss Xizor's failure to seduce [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Pheromones''' were chemicals secreted by one lifeform to influence the behavior of other lifeforms, most often to attract members of another [[Gender/Legends|sex]]. 

Though normally targeting members of the same species, some species such as the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] and [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]] had unusually powerful pheromones that could affect other [[humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] or [[sentience/Legends|sentient]] races. These two species were also unusual in that they could exude pheromones at will, rather than unconsciously. Falleen sometimes could get the best result with exercise and concentration.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] released pheromones to attract a mate, as they relied on machines to breed. [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] pheromones were often described as foul-smelling.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]], a Rodian dancer, wore bracelets that would suppress her pheromones.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] communicated through pheromones, and created a device that could analyze their pheromones and translate them into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], to help them communicate with other species.
